entities.summary: Jamie-Lee Rattray is a Canadian professional ice hockey player for the Boston Fleet of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL). An Olympic gold medalist from the 2022 Beijing Winter Games, she has won multiple medals with the Canada women's national ice hockey team, including gold medals at the 2021, 2022, and 2024 World Championships.
